summary: Offer /compact on a Claude chat that is both token-heavy (100k+) and stale (70+ minutes idle), and hide the context meter until the backend reports real usage.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android after ThreadPresentation gains the offer row and RoomThreadSnapshotStore records lastTurnAt; the shared thresholds live in src/shared/compaction-offer.ts and the RN implementation is the reference

sharedBackendApi.reason: No new channel or event. Compact is an ordinary sendTurn of the text /compact, which the Claude SDK parses as its own slash command. The adapter already reports the compacting status and re-reads usage afterwards (src/main/provider/adapters/claude-adapter.ts, compact_result handling).

storageDataMigration.reason: Dismissal is in-memory per pane and per session id; nothing is persisted.

updateRelease.reason: Renderer-only change in the desktop bundle. No wire, protocol, or capability change, so mixed desktop/server versions behave as before.

notExercised: The banner has not been observed against a live Claude session with 100k+ tokens and 70 minutes idle; the threshold logic is unit-tested and the /compact send path is the existing slash passthrough.
The React Native banner has not been rendered on a device; the shared decision is unit-tested and the send path is the existing outbox with a text override.
